description: Avoid single-character variable names outside of trivial loop counters
Cache repeated database lookups and expensive calculations
Never interpolate raw user input directly into SQL queries; always use parameterized queries
Never commit hardcoded secrets API tokens or credentials into source code
Sanitize and escape all user-controlled data before rendering into HTML to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
Avoid N+1 queries in ORMs by utilizing eager loading or batch fetch queries
Always check for and handle null or undefined or nil pointers before dereferencing
Ensure mutexes and locks are released using defer or finally blocks to prevent deadlocks
Enforce single responsibility: separate HTTP handlers business logic and persistence layers
Define explicit return types and parameter types for all public interfaces and functions
Use buffered I/O streams and avoid reading entire large files directly into memory
Verify JWT signatures with asymmetric keys and enforce short-lived expiration timestamps
Handle floating-point arithmetic using arbitrary precision decimals for monetary values
Avoid global mutable state; prefer explicit dependency injection
Validate and constrain all array indices and slice bounds to prevent buffer overflows and panics
